title: Cross-Tensor Activation Rescaler: INT8-Compatible Calibration & Fused Kernel Adapter
creator: Ava Patel
description: Deliver an activation-aware INT8 quantization path that performs cross-tensor rescaling (trainingless) at calibration time and provides runtime kernel adapters for fused operators and KV-cache safe execution. This ticket covers: (1) calibration harness to generate per-layer activation rescale profiles for INT8 deployment (compatible with weight per-channel quantization), (2) a lightweight profile format and on-disk cache, (3) runtime kernel shims to apply rescale factors for fused attention/MLP ops and ensure KV-cache consistency, and (4) evaluation guardrails and rollout strategy to measure and limit accuracy regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness produces stable rescale profiles for 90%+ of models in our catalog using 1k token seed runs
End-to-end INT8 inference using rescale profiles matches FP16 baseline perplexity delta <3% across validation suite
Runtime adapters (fused attention + fused MLP) pass CI GPU smoke tests and do not increase median latency by >8% at target batch sizes
Fallback path implemented: if live-quality regression >5% for a customer route, system auto-routes to FP16 or alternative INT8 variant
Artifacts: calibration profiles stored in standardized .rescale format and referenced in model metadata; PR with tests and docs merged
test_plan: Run calibration on RedwoodWebText-1M-sample and LlamaEval-S 1k-token subsets
Evaluate on held-out evals: perplexity (WikiText-like), TruthfulQA small, long-form generation sample checks
A/B traffic test on non-critical customer route (5% traffic) with monitoring for perplexity, token-level edit rate, and latency
GPU microbenchmarks: 1-token latency, 8-token tail latencies, and throughput at batching=32/64
Regression harness: run 10 deterministic prompts and diff outputs token-by-token with tolerances and stochasticity seeds
comments: 2026-02-10 - Ava Patel: Created ticket. Initial scope to avoid per-layer retraining; prioritize a trainingless rescale approach similar to academic activation-aware quant methods but integrated with our runtime and KV cache semantics.

2026-02-16 - Marcus Chen: Spike complete. Prototype computes cross-tensor RMS on fused attention input and produces stable float32 rescale factors. Calibration run on Llama-7B sample (1k examples) shows avg scale factor range 0.6-1.8. Baseline FP16 PPL 14.9, INT8 w/ naive quant 16.8, INT8 w/ rescale 15.1 (delta +1.3%).
2026-02-19 - Design review with Priya Singh: Discussed profile format and Console UX for viewing rescale profile per model. Agreed to store human-readable JSON index plus compressed binary profile.

2026-02-25 - Marcus Chen: Implementation notes: using per-channel weight quantization + cross-tensor activation rescale applied as pre-op on fused kernels. Added kernel flag to indicate 'rescale-applied' to preserve backward compatibility.

2026-03-02 - Diego Alvarez (Review): Left feedback on PR #4321: prefer saturating int8 path with explicit overflow counters; suggested adding CI check for KV-cache deterministic replay after rescale. Action: add overflow counters and add test vector.

2026-03-05 - Marcus Chen: Added overflow counters and KV-cache consistency tests. Initial CI GPU smoke failing on fused MLP kernel for sequence length 2048; root cause: accumulation order change due to rescale magnitude. Mitigation: runtime path uses compensated accumulation in kernel when 'rescale' flag is set.

2026-03-11 - Performance: Grafana dashboard link updated with production-like perf numbers for Llama-13B with rescale adapters: median latency +6% at batch=8, throughput within 95% of FP16 for steady-state workloads. Added to artifacts.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Chen: Marking core work complete. Need PM signoff on rollout plan and UX docs before closing. Planned canary next week.

Follow-up: Consider hybrid strategy where first N layers use FP16 or FP8 and the rest use INT8 + rescale for latency/cost tradeoffs
risks: Accuracy regressions for text-generation tasks that rely on small activation dynamics (dialogue, code completion). Need tight guardrails.
Increased kernel complexity could surface platform-specific numerical differences across GPU driver versions—must tighten CI sampling across driver versions and architectures.
KV-cache scaling edge cases for long context lengths may require dynamic per-slot rescale adjustments; complexity could push us to an interim conservative rollout.
Failure modes: rescale overflow or saturation leading to OOM or NaNs; mitigated with overflow counters and autoswitch to FP16 path
decisions: Decided on trainingless calibration (no retraining) to meet product timelines and support legacy models.
Profile storage: use compact binary .rescale file plus JSON index; include model hash and seed metadata to detect stale profiles.
Runtime: introduce kernel 'rescale' flag with compensated accumulation and optional dequant fallback for sequences > 2048 tokens.
Quality threshold for auto-rollbacks: delta PPL >5% or token-level edit rate >7% triggers fallback routing
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (Canary): Internal traffic only, 0% external customers. Monitor perf and quality for 48h.
Stage 2 (Limited Beta): Route 5% of traffic for non-SLA customer routes with opt-in. Trigger auto-fallback on quality regressions.
Stage 3 (Gradual): 25% -> 50% -> 100% across compatible model families after 7 days of stable metrics.
Safety: kill-switch in Console to disable rescale per model and per-route; automatic reversion to FP16 or alternative INT8 variant
notes: Explore FP8 hybrid path in follow-up ticket if rescale shows consistent delta <1% and further cost savings are required.
Coordinate with Platform team for driver matrix CI (NVIDIA 530+, AMD ROCm targets) before wide rollout.
PM to create Console UX for rescale profile visibility and ability to pin fallback thresholds per-customer
